title: Fix three bugs in a Go token bucket rate limiter
description: A token bucket rate limiter has three bugs: refill adds tokens to wrong field, Allow checks wrong condition, and tokens can exceed capacity.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix two bugs in ratelimit.go:
1. `refill`: change `l.capacity += elapsed * l.rate` to `l.tokens += elapsed * l.rate` so tokens are added to the bucket, not capacity
2. `refill`: add `if l.tokens > l.capacity { l.tokens = l.capacity }` after adding tokens to cap at capacity
3. `Allow`: change `if l.tokens >= 0` to `if l.tokens >= 1` so at least one full token is required
All 2 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
